newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Centaur buys stake in Siberia nickel.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Centaur buys stake in Siberia nickel.

text.p: Merritt Mining NL and Sand Queen Gold Mines NL said on Monday they had reached an agreement with Joseph Gutnick's Centaur Mining and Exploration Ltd which allowed Centaur to buy an 80 percent interest in Western Australia's Siberia nickel project for A$2 million.
Merritt and Sand Queen, which currently hold 50 percent each of the project, said in a statement they would then be free-carried by Centaur until a decision to mine was made.
Siberia, northwest of Ora Banda in Western Australia, was located west of the Cawse nickel-cobalt project being brought into production by Centaur, they said.

Merritt had drilled widespread rotary air blast holes at Siberia to discover a significant nickel resource, with several holes in the centre having intersections greater than one per cent nickel, the statement said.
